name: StratMamba
title: Strategic and Reactive Stream Partitioning for Path-Efficient LiDAR-Based Obstacle Avoidance
alt: StratMamba architecture with reactive proximity and strategic goal streams
summary: Dual-stream Mamba policies balance reactive obstacle avoidance with strategic navigation, with simulation training and deployment on a real quadruped.

name: CommCP
title: Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination via LLM-Based Communication with Conformal Prediction
alt: CommCP framework for multi-robot question answering and calibrated communication
summary: Conformal prediction calibrates language-model messages so collaborating robots exchange useful information reliably in multi-agent embodied question answering.

name: GUIDES
title: Guidance Using Instructor-Distilled Embeddings for Pre-Trained Robot Policy Enhancement
alt: GUIDES framework injecting semantic guidance into pre-trained robot policies
summary: Instructor-distilled embeddings give existing robot policies semantic guidance, while a reasoning-based reflector improves robustness when instructions are uncertain.

name: LaMMA-P
title: Generalizable Multi-Agent Long-Horizon Task Allocation and Planning with LM-Driven PDDL Planner
alt: LaMMA-P language-model and PDDL planning framework for heterogeneous robots
summary: Language-model reasoning and PDDL planning support long-horizon, capability-aware task allocation for heterogeneous robot teams, evaluated with the MAT-THOR benchmark.

name: Safe Crowd Navigation
title: Towards Generalizable Safety in Crowd Navigation via Conformal Uncertainty Handling
alt: Uncertainty-aware crowd navigation with conformal inference and constrained reinforcement learning
summary: Adaptive conformal inference estimates pedestrian uncertainty and guides constrained reinforcement learning for safer navigation under distribution shifts.

name: HEAL
title: An Empirical Study on Hallucinations in Embodied Agents Driven by Large Language Models
alt: HEAL hallucination probing and embodied-agent evaluation settings
summary: A systematic study of hallucinations in language-model-driven embodied agents, examining how misleading scene and task information affects robotic planning.

name: Robot-Assisted Strawberry Harvesting
title: Enhancing Efficiency of Human Pickers in Strawberry Harvesting With Quadruped Robots
alt: Overview illustration of quadruped robots transporting trays for human strawberry pickers
summary: Quadruped robots transport harvested crops while predictive scheduling adapts to uncertain picker behavior, reducing time spent away from harvesting.
image_source: Overview illustration based on the paper; not a reproduced experimental figure.

name: Coordinated Legged-Robot Teams
title: Accounting for Travel Time and Arrival Time Coordination During Task Allocations in Legged-Robot Teams
alt: USC quadruped robot platform used in legged-robot research
summary: Task allocation accounts for robot travel time and coordinated arrival, supporting more efficient collaboration among legged robots.
